sourceDescription: The current official CIT People route resolves to the Professors directory. The snapshot preserves every named entry across current Professors, Affiliated, Adjunct, Honorary, Emeriti of Excellence, Retired, and TUM Distinguished Affiliated Professor sections. Twelve people occur in more than one section, so 282 section entries resolve to 270 unique people. Status categories are retained for later person-level classification.
